name: Cuckoo
summary: Schedule a message on a carved cuckoo clock; when it strikes, the bird pops out and delivers it
about: A send-later composer next to a wooden cuckoo clock whose face is the time picker. Drag the face, use the arrow keys or tap a quick time, then press Schedule: your note folds into an envelope and flies into the little door, and a red pin marks the send time while the hands show the real time. Send now makes the hands race to the pin, the door bursts open and the bird calls twice before flying the letter away.
how: Pick In 1 hour, Tonight 9 PM or Tomorrow 8 AM, or drag the clock face (crossing XII flips AM and PM).
With the face focused, arrow keys move 5 minutes and Page Up or Page Down move an hour. Today, Tomorrow, AM and PM are buttons too.
Press Schedule: the door opens, the note folds into an envelope and the countdown starts from the real time.
Press Send now (or wait for the time): the hands race round, the bird springs out, calls and flies the letter off.
Cancel brings the envelope back out of the door, and a time that has already passed moves to tomorrow.
